description: Makes a link for the person in this chat to open in their own browser, signed in to Cosend, to do one set-up step only they can do there, and returns its url. It works for 30 minutes and only for them, and carries no password or key. kind connect_number connects a WhatsApp number; connect_integrations needs connectors (each integration by its Cosend key, as GET /v1/connectors lists them) and completes when every one has an account; upgrade needs plan, the plan to buy; payment_method adds a card. The person does the step themselves on the page: they connect the number in Meta’s window, pay in Stripe’s Checkout, or add the card. It cannot be done for them. A new link of the same kind cancels the workspace’s open one, whoever made it.

connectors.description: The integrations the person signs in to, by key from GET /v1/connectors. The link completes when every one of them has an account.

plan.description: The plan to buy, by code from GET /v1/billing/plans. Only for a workspace with no paid subscription yet, and only up.

name: create_setup_link
title: Make a set-up link
